import myapp.auth as auth

Authentication

Overview | Quickstart | Authentication

Overview

All API requests must be authenticated using a JWT token. Tokens are issued via the /v2/token endpoint.

Python SDK Example

Install the SDK:

pip install myapp-sdk==2.3.1

Use the SDK to obtain a token:

import myapp.auth as auth

client = auth.Client(
    client_id="YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
    client_secret="YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
    api_base="https://api.myapp.com/v2"
)

try:
    token = client.get_token(scopes=["read", "write"])
    print("Access token:", token.access_token)
except auth.AuthenticationError as e:
    # Traceback will point to the SDK source file
    # /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/myapp/auth.py:45
    print("Failed to obtain token:", e)

Node.js SDK Example

Install the SDK:

npm install @myapp/sdk@1.4.0

Use the SDK to obtain a token:

const MyApp = require('@myapp/sdk');

const client = new MyApp.AuthClient({
  clientId: process.env.MYAPP_CLIENT_ID,
  clientSecret: process.env.MYAPP_CLIENT_SECRET,
  apiBase: 'https://api.myapp.com/v2'
});

client.getToken(['read', 'write'])
  .then(token => {
    console.log('Access token:', token.accessToken);
  })
  .catch(err => {
    // Error originates from:
    // /home/user/project/node_modules/@myapp/sdk/lib/auth.js:78
    console.error('Authentication failed:', err.message);
  });

Go SDK Example

Install the SDK:

go get github.com/myapp/sdk@v0.9.2

Use the SDK to obtain a token:

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "github.com/myapp/sdk/auth"
)

func main() {
    client := auth.NewClient(auth.Config{
        ClientID:     "YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
        ClientSecret: "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
        APIBase:      "https://api.myapp.com/v2",
    })

    token, err := client.GetToken([]string{"read", "write"})
    if err != nil {
        // Error source:
        // $GOPATH/pkg/mod/github.com/myapp/sdk@v0.9.2/auth/auth.go:112
        log.Fatalf("failed to get token: %v", err)
    }
    fmt.Println("Access token:", token.AccessToken)
}

Common Errors

  • Invalid client credentials – Ensure client_id and client_secret are correct.
  • Token validation failed – Example error message: 
    error: token validation failed: signature mismatch (expected alg HS256)
